answer_text: Per our ILMM Service Terms, Service Level Credits are calculated as a percentage of the total ILMM fees for the affected Site(s) in the applicable month, with a cap of 15% of the fees per site per month. The KB does not list a fixed credit amount for a specific outage (e.g., Aug 21 INC-4471). To confirm the exact credit, please provide the affected Site(s) and the outage severity/impact per our SLA, and I’ll verify the credit amount for Aug 21 right away.
